criterion: blast radius: caller whose contract the diff changed but did not update or cover
finding: The remedy 'Re-run /afk:setup' depends on setup's O5 probe, and that probe never reads the stub name field, so a re-run can skip the re-copy and leave the old name installed.
why: The O5 probe (skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md:867-870) passes when each stub has the same filename and a baked plugin root that exists, and setup runs its Fix (the copy) only after a failed probe. When the baked root still exists, for example a same-version or dev install or a root taken from PLUGIN_ROOT (inferred, not run), setup reports the stubs healthy and the Codex spawn of `afk-reader` still fails as an unknown agent type. INV-081's own ledger records node B8:skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md:867 with impact_verdict "breaks" and pinned_by "unguarded", yet REPORT.md's Sites list leaves it out, and the slice neither updates O5 nor records an IOU in .claude/wiring-ious.md.
fix: Add the name-field check (`name = "afk-<role>"`) to the O5 probe in skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md, through a plan decision since MANIFEST.md is outside ## Scope, or record an anchored wiring IOU and word the changelog and PROVIDERS.md:23 so they do not promise that setup alone refreshes the name.
evidence: CHANGELOG.md:106-107 "Re-run `/afk:setup` so the copies in `~/.codex/agents/` take the new name."; PROVIDERS.md:23 "re-run `/afk:setup` so the copies in `~/.codex/agents/` carry it"; MANIFEST.md:867 "**Probe:** each `providers/codex/agents/afk-afk-*.toml` is present under `~/.codex/agents/` with the same filename, its `{{PLUGIN_ROOT}}` placeholder is replaced by a plugin root that **exists on disk**"; INV-081 COVERAGE.json node {"id": "B13:skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md:867", "reason": "... it never compares the name field, so an installed old-name stub passes while its baked root exists (inferred)"} and {"id": "B8:skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md:867", "impact_verdict": "breaks"}

finding: Possible stale stub: 're-run /afk:setup' does not always refresh the name field, because setup's O5 probe never checks it.
why: Setup's O5 probe passes when three things hold: the filename is present, the placeholder is resolved, and the baked root exists and contains LANGUAGE.md and agents/. An installed copy that still reads name = "afk-afk-reader" meets all three, so the fix never runs and Codex keeps rejecting a spawn of `afk-reader` as an unknown agent type. Two cases reach this. (a) A reinstall at the same plugin version. (b) A stub whose baked root is the marketplace directory, which the probe accepts. That directory being versionless and surviving an upgrade is inferred, not verified. INV-081 lists the O5 overwrite question as unverified (c-53c67584).
fix: Make the O5 probe also compare each installed stub's name line with its source, which is a MANIFEST.md edit owned by setup. Otherwise tell the user to delete the old copies before running setup again.
evidence: PROVIDERS.md:23 "re-run `/afk:setup` so the copies in `~/.codex/agents/` carry it"; CHANGELOG.md:107 "Re-run `/afk:setup` so the copies in `~/.codex/agents/` take the new name."; skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md:867-870 "Probe: each `providers/codex/agents/afk-afk-*.toml` is present under `~/.codex/agents/` with the same filename, its `{{PLUGIN_ROOT}}` placeholder is replaced by a plugin root that exists on disk and contains `LANGUAGE.md` and `agents/`"

criterion: error and rollback paths / partial-failure handling
finding: The rule says nothing about a single-model role that has no reachable equivalent, so the agent has no defined action on that path.
why: The sentence gives only two outcomes: a single-model role continues, and a debate role waits. Three reachable inputs leave a single-model role with neither. (1) The other column's cell does not name a model; the guard clause 'where that cell names a model' admits this case and then drops it. (2) The substitute provider also fails a call. From the substitute's side, 'another harness column' is the column that already failed, so read literally the role swaps back and forth between the two models, never waits, and never reaches the 'wait past the provider's limit parks' clause. (3) The active harness has no way to start the other column's model, for example a role running as an in-harness subagent with no pane transport. This last case is inferred from CONFORMANCE.md:440: Claude agent pins are Claude aliases. PRD AC-022 limits substitution to 'where the tier map supplies one', which implies wait-then-park for these cases, but the sentence does not say so.
fix: Add a clause such as 'a single-model role with no equivalent, or whose equivalent also fails, waits like a debate role', so the existing wait-then-park clause covers it.
evidence: PROVIDERS.md:138 "a role that runs one model continues on the equivalent model from another provider, which is the same tier row in another harness column where that cell names a model, and a role in a debate pattern waits; ... a wait past the provider's limit parks the run"; PRD.md:122 AC-022 "continues on an equivalent model from another provider, where the tier map supplies one"

finding: Nothing checks that each stub's name field equals its role. The declared static check only proves the old prefix is gone, not that the new name is correct.
why: The Verification row's `grep -c '^name = "afk-afk-'` prints 0 is an absence check: a stub with a typo such as `name = "afk-runer"` or no name line passes it, yet the row claims 'every stub carries the skill name'. Only afk-reader is checked positively, and INV-081 records that no test or gate guards this change, so a revert or a typo ships green.
